text.p: International Post Ltd said it has tentatively agreed to acquire privately-held Video Services Corp in exchange for some 6.7 million common shares.
This block of stock "will represent in excess of 50 percent of the outstanding shares" after the merger, International Post said.

It said that in the year ending September 30, the Northvale, N.J., based-Video Services had revenues of $32.3 million and an EBITDA of $6.9 million. EBITDA stands for an earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
At September 30, its debt stood at $4.0 million.
In the year ended October 31, International Post had revenues of $50.9 million and EBITDA of $12.4 million. Total debt at October 31 was $30.8 million.
Terrance A. Elkes, International Post's chairman will continue as chairman after the merger.
Louis H. Sircusano; chairman, president and chief executive of Video Services and a director of International Post, will become president and chief executive officer.
International Post's president and chief executive, Martin Irwin, will become vice chairman.
